_comment: Season regulation per league, keyed by database league id. Window/transfer months are MM-DD and recur every year. Collected from Wikipedia season articles on 2026-11-20; 'filled' marks values replaced by the class default because the source did not state them, 'confidence' marks proxy seasons, 'inherited_from' marks a lower division that copies the country's top-division window without its own source.
